name: Ahmed Mahmoud
headline: Travel & Tourism Operations
work_authorisation: Authorised to work in the Netherlands. No employer sponsorship required.
summary: Travel and tourism professional with experience across Egypt and the UAE, now based in Den Haag. Background in destination services, multilingual guest communication, B2B reservations, guest and supplier coordination, transport planning and cross-functional operations support.

career.scope: Destination management and cross-functional DMC support
contributions: Supported approximately 350 guests per month and groups up to 45 through destination services, transport, ticketing, supplier coordination and service recovery.
Contributed to MICE, FAM and industry-event operations, including airport and hotel representation, guest movements, venues and live stakeholder communication.
Developed airport-representative procedures and operational handovers; supported Strapi Arabic localisation, BOS and Otolo Homes workflows, colleague coaching and a Travel Desk DMAIC project.
Coordinated destination programmes for international groups up to 35, including hotel pickups, transport, tickets, attractions, timing and supplier interfaces.
Protected itinerary continuity during delays and live changes through multilingual guest communication and service recovery.
Handled approximately 120 B2B booking and case transactions per day using Juniper and Freshdesk.
Supported French-speaking hotel markets in Tunisia, Morocco and Algeria; resolved booking discrepancies, amendments, rates, refunds and relocations through partner and internal-team coordination.

career.scope: Excursions, airport transfers and guest services
contributions: Coordinated daily destination programmes, excursions, airport arrivals, departures and transfers for multinational groups up to 19.
Handled guest issues and programme changes while maintaining timing, safety and service standards, including support for CIS and Russian-speaking markets.
Coordinated approximately 15 vehicles and drivers, daily allocation, GPS follow-up, maintenance schedules, insurance administration and operational readiness.
Supported transport operations connected to the 2021 IHF Men's World Championship, including movements between airports, hotels and competition venues.

career.scope: Leisure packages and Hajj and Umrah group travel
contributions: Designed, quoted and sold leisure, honeymoon and couple packages; coordinated itineraries, hotels, suppliers and customer follow-up.
Managed Hajj and Umrah arrangements, flights, visas and documentation, accommodation in Makkah and Madinah, and programme coordination using SAFA and Amadeus workflows.
